evals.name: team-invitations-contract
evals.prompt: Turn this into acceptance criteria before implementation: add team invitations with roles (admin/member) and a 7-day expiry, including revoke and resend. Use the repo for context but focus on invitations.
evals.expected_output: Testable rules, edge cases, failure behavior, permissions, non-goals, open questions, and a definition of done.
assertions: Writes observable Given/When/Then or rule-based criteria
Covers expiry boundary, used/revoked token, duplicate member, and non-owner authorization
Covers failure behavior such as email failure, double accept, and invalid token
Includes a definition of done and open questions
Avoids prescribing implementation details such as Redis or specific tables
